archetypes.name: prompt-tally-contract
archetypes.rationale: Self-review prompt accounting depends on exact artifact headings and count substitution.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the self-review Step 5 prompt contract. Verify accepted and rejected counts come only from the documented durable artifacts, placeholders cannot be invoked as-is, and the single-line tally fence shape remains compatible with the launcher harness. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: run-log-semantics
archetypes.rationale: Docs and tests must align self-review tally semantics with existing run-log consumers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that the run-log documentation preserves normal panel review semantics while carving out self-review mode accurately. Confirm the tests assert non-zero counts without implying review-findings-full.jsonl is populated for self-review. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
